input.quote: EXCEPT FOR LIABILITY ARISING UNDER SECTION 8 OF THIS AGREEMENT, IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF THIS AGREEMENT OR THE USE OR PERFORMANCE OF THE SOFTWARE EXCEED THE TOTAL AMOUNT ACTUALLY PAID BY CORIO HEREUNDER FOR THE TRANSACTION WHICH THE LIABILITY RELATES TO DURING THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRIOR TO THE FILING OF THE CAUSE OF ACTION TO WHICH THE LIABILITY RELATES.
input.rationale: Section 9 caps both parties, but the basis is not 12 months' fees: it is limited to amounts "ACTUALLY PAID BY CORIO ... FOR THE TRANSACTION WHICH THE LIABILITY RELATES TO", a per-transaction slice of fees that can fall well below even six months' fees and so fails the fallback on cap size (and risks walk-away territory for Commerce One's exposure). Carve-outs are also short of the fallback: only Section 8 (Commerce One's IP indemnity) sits outside the cap, while breach of the confidentiality obligation in Section 10, gross negligence, wilful misconduct and fraud are all capped. The mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages is acceptable. Our redline moves the cap to the preferred basis (greater of 12 months' fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000) and adds Section 10, gross negligence, wilful misconduct and fraud as uncapped carve-outs, keeping the existing sentence structure. We did not add the "payment obligations are not damages" clarification, which is a minor sub-element rather than a separate deviation.

proposal.summary: Make the cap the greater of 12 months' fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000, and carve out confidentiality, gross negligence, wilful misconduct and fraud.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Our position is a mutual cap set at the greater of twelve months' fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000, so we have replaced the narrow "amount paid for the transaction to which the liability relates" basis. We have also placed breach of confidentiality (Section 10), gross negligence, wilful misconduct and fraud outside the cap alongside the existing Section 8 indemnity carve-out.

ops.newText: EXCEPT FOR LIABILITY ARISING UNDER SECTION 8 OR SECTION 10 OF THIS AGREEMENT, OR ARISING OUT OF A PARTY'S GROSS NEGLIGENCE, WILLFUL MISCONDUCT OR FRAUD, IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF THIS AGREEMENT OR THE USE OR PERFORMANCE OF THE SOFTWARE EXCEED THE GREATER OF (A) THE TOTAL AMOUNT PAID OR PAYABLE BY CORIO HEREUNDER DURING THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING THE EVENT GIVING RISE TO THE LIABILITY AND (B) ONE MILLION U.S. DOLLARS (US $1,000,000).
